blocks.content: Article 243G specifies the powers, authority and responsibilities of Panchayats over 29 functional matters listed in the Eleventh Schedule.

items: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act added the Eleventh Schedule along with Part IX to the Constitution in 1992.
Always remember the total number of functional matters in the Eleventh Schedule is 29.
Do not confuse the Eleventh Schedule (Panchayats - 29 items, Art. 243G) with the Twelfth Schedule (Municipalities - 18 items, Art. 243W).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Eleventh Schedule was added to the Constitution of India by the 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 1992.
It contains 29 functional items placed within the jurisdiction and purview of Panchayats.
Article 243G specifies the powers, authority, and responsibilities of Panchayats regarding economic development and social justice.
Key functional areas include agriculture, land improvement, minor irrigation, animal husbandry, rural housing, and drinking water.
It provides a constitutional framework for devolution of powers to local self-government institutions in rural areas.
